name: year offset range no duplicate base years
description: Verifies that year_offset range columns do not expand base_years and do not produce a redundant LEFT JOIN when no WHERE filter exists on the offset column
expected_query: with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[${Array.from({ length: current_season.year - 2023 }, (_, i) => 2024 + i).join(',')}]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years WHERE player.primary_position IN ('RB')), "tb834ac555626e81e1daed29eedc6b8a2" as materialized (select COALESCE(ball_carrier_pid) as pid, "nfl_plays"."season_year" as "year", SUM(CASE WHEN ball_carrier_pid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rush_atts_from_plays from "nfl_plays" where not "play_type" = 'NOPL' and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2024) group by "nfl_plays"."season_year", COALESCE(ball_carrier_pid)), "t87075b57e501ad078f5974e72da66061" as materialized (select COALESCE(ball_carrier_pid) as pid, "nfl_plays"."season_year" as "year", SUM(CASE WHEN ball_carrier_pid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rush_atts_from_plays from "nfl_plays" where not "play_type" = 'NOPL' and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (${Array.from({ length: current_season.year - 2024 }, (_, i) => 2025 + i).join(', ')}) group by "nfl_plays"."season_year", COALESCE(ball_carrier_pid)) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "tb834ac555626e81e1daed29eedc6b8a2"."rush_atts_from_plays" AS "rush_atts_from_plays_0", (SELECT SUM(t87075b57e501ad078f5974e72da66061.rush_atts_from_plays) FROM t87075b57e501ad078f5974e72da66061 WHERE t87075b57e501ad078f5974e72da66061.pid = player.pid AND t87075b57e501ad078f5974e72da66061.year BETWEEN player_years.year + 1 AND player_years.year + 30) AS "rush_atts_from_plays_1", "player_years"."year", "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years" on "player_years"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "tb834ac555626e81e1daed29eedc6b8a2" on "tb834ac555626e81e1daed29eedc6b8a2"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "tb834ac555626e81e1daed29eedc6b8a2"."year" = 2024 where player.primary_position IN ('RB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "tb834ac555626e81e1daed29eedc6b8a2"."rush_atts_from_plays", "player_years"."year", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by 4 DESC NULLS LAST, "player"."pid" asc limit 500
